milestone: M4 (3D sessile: 90 degrees, D38; 60 and 120 degrees added 2026-10-22)
status: APPROVED (tracker D38, 2026-10-10); the protocol runs wait for the 3D interface-preserving redistancing (D38 item 4). Amended by decision D43 (2026-10-19, before the R/h = 16 dt/2 run): the sector angle is averaged over 21 rotations of the sector partition, and the time-step criterion is judged at R/h = 16. Extended on 2026-10-22, before any run at the new angles, to the equilibrium angles 60 and 120 degrees (each started from 90 degrees, the sessile_drop_2d pairs) with every criterion and limit unchanged; the extension was approved as written by decision D48 item 3 (2026-10-22), before its first run
fixed_on: 2026-10-10, decision D38, before the first protocol run

protocol.domain: quarter: x >= 0, z >= 0, drop axis on x = z = 0; the planes x = 0 and z = 0 are free-slip symmetry planes (zero normal velocity only), not contact walls. The full domain (--domain full) is the symmetry check, not part of the protocol.
protocol.configuration: Decision D4, as sessile_drop_2d: Contact_line_model=PrescribedAngle on the bottom wall, Wall_slip_model=Navier, strong zero normal-only velocity on the contact wall, SurfaceStress capillary form, no reinitialization; PDE velocity extension (D9), kinematic reconciliation and sign-definite patch bounds on. Decisions D38/D39: the triggered interface-preserving redistancing (Enable_interface_preserving_redistancing, after the reconciliation, once the interface has moved one cell) is on in the protocol, as in sessile_drop_2d.
protocol.time_step: Decisions D25 and D38: the fixed step dt = 0.02 at La = 12 for both levels, with the lagged normal-increment capillary term (Surface_tension_semi_implicit=NormalIncrement), rounded down to the 200 output intervals of D29 (dt = T/1400 = 1.7496e-2, 1.40 and 3.97 times the capillary limit dt_B of R/h = 8 and 16). --dt-rule capillary-limit is the 2D sessile rule (each level's dt_B, no lagged term).
protocol.reference: spherical cap on y = 0 with the Young angle and the volume V(0)/f of the sampled initial level set (f = 1/4 for the quarter domain): R_ref = (V/(pi (2 - 3 cos theta_e + cos^3 theta_e)/3))^(1/3), base radius R_ref sin(theta_e), apex height R_ref (1 - cos(theta_e))
protocol.note: Each equilibrium angle is its own study, and verify.py takes the runs of one angle at a time. Criteria apply to the quarter-domain study of the protocol dt rule at dt divisor 1 (both levels); the dt/2 study needs R/h = 16 only (time_step_criterion, decision D43; before D43 it was R/h = 8, whose pair is now reported, not gated). R/h = 32 is not affordable in 3D (as D25). See README.md for the definitions and the cost.

time_step_criterion.source: Decisions D25 (one dt/2 check level in 3D), D38 (the dt/2 check validates the fixed-step NormalIncrement rule) and D43 (the check is judged at R/h = 16, as in 2D: at R/h = 8 the sector angle varies by 0.07-0.15 degrees under 5-degree rotations of the sector partition and cannot resolve 0.1 degree), with the sessile_drop_2d time_step_criterion end-state limits (1/20 of the M4 gates)
time_step_criterion.tracks: Decision D38 item 3: the limits follow the 2D sessile time-step decision (D35 item 4); 0.1 degree and 0.1% until then, and they change with the 2D limits if those change
time_step_criterion.definition: Between the dt divisor 1 and 2 quarter-domain studies at R/h = 16 (decision D43), at the end of the run: the largest change of a sector contact angle, max over the sectors of |theta(dt) - theta(dt/2)| with theta the rotation-averaged sector angle of the contact_angle criterion and the sectors matched by their nominal centre azimuth, and the relative changes of the base radius and the apex height. The single-partition angle change is reported alongside. The same changes at every other level run at both divisors (R/h = 8) are reported, not gated (D43 item 2; the R/h = 8 pair of job 51 is recorded as a FAIL under the D38 definition, D43 item 1).
time_step_criterion.reported_step_levels: every level other than refined_step_levels run at both divisors (R/h = 8): changes reported, not gated (D43)
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion applies to the dt study; at dt/2 the criteria at R/h = 16 or 'each' apply ('each': every dt/2 run verified), the others are reported as not evaluated, and so is a criterion at R/h = 16 when no R/h = 16 dt/2 run is verified; the angle trend over 8/16 is evaluated at dt/2 only when both levels are verified at dt/2
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail. The same holds when R/h = 16 lacks one of the two divisors, whatever the other levels

criteria.definition: max over the azimuthal sectors of 30 degrees of the contact line of |theta - theta_e| at the end of the run. theta of a sector is measured through the liquid from a circle fitted to the meridional projection (distance from the drop axis, height) of the interface points (edge zero crossings of phi_h) of the sector with 0 <= y <= 0.25 R_ref, at the circle point at the mean radius of the sector's wall zero crossings. Decision D43: theta of a sector is the mean of this single-partition angle over 21 rotations of the sector partition by the offsets -5, -4.5, ..., +5 degrees (sector_rotations). A sector keeps its identity, its nominal centre azimuth, in every rotation; in the quarter domain the outer edges of the partition stay on the symmetry planes (azimuth 0 and 90 degrees), so a rotation moves only the interior boundaries, and in the full domain the partition rotates periodically. The max deviation is formed from the averaged angles. The single-partition (offset 0) angles, their max deviation and the spread over the rotations are reported. The mean over the sectors and the cell-gradient angles along the line are reported.

sector_rotations.source: decision D43 item 3: the single-partition angle at R/h = 8 jumps by up to 0.3 degree when a wall crossing on a sector boundary changes sector

criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion (angle error <= 2 degrees, decreasing), read as in sessile_drop_2d (the largest error over the contact line; in 2D the two contact points); gating level R/h = 16 with the trend over 8/16, as decision D25 for the 3D static sphere

criteria.definition: |b - b_ref| / b_ref at the end of the run; b is the mean distance of the wall zero crossings of phi_h from the drop axis
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion (base radius within 2%), at the level of the angle criterion

criteria.definition: |H - H_ref| / H_ref at the end of the run; H is the largest height above the wall of the interface points
criteria.source: Tracker section 5, M4 working criterion (apex height within 2%), at the level of the angle criterion

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |V(t) - V(0)| / V(0), V the exact volume of {phi_h < 0} and V(0) that of the sampled initial level set
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (volume drift <= 1e-4), gated on the maximum over the run (D11)

criteria.definition: max|u_h| (liquid vertices) at the end of the run divided by the largest max|u_h| over the outputs with T/2 <= t <= 3T/4
criteria.rest_capillary_floor_rule: the ratio is reported for every run; it is gated only when mu max|u_h|/gamma at the last output is at least rest_capillary_floor, and verify.py states the branch taken
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (no growth of max|u| in time), as sessile_drop_2d; decision D39: not gated for a run whose final capillary number mu max|u_h|/gamma (last output) is below rest_capillary_floor (a drop at rest), reported either way
